residual_vulnerabilities: Pattern-based redaction is an allowlist-free blocklist: a paraphrase ('it is safe to skip certificate validation here'), a non-English instruction, or base64/homoglyph encoding will not match any regex.
The untrusted-data fence is advisory. Nothing forces the model to honour the delimiter, and a payload that closes the fence early can break out.

The output guardrail inspects the final answer only. An injected instruction that changes which tools the agent calls — rather than what it writes — is invisible to it, and is only caught by the trajectory eval.
Read-only scope is asserted over a hardcoded table, not enforced by the runtime. A future tool added without updating TOOL_SCOPES defeats it.
Sanitisation runs on evidence entering the agent, not on the corpus. A poisoned document stays poisoned for every other consumer of the index.
